scope_quote: Health New Zealand is seeking proposals for a cloud-based electronic wayfinding and pathfinding solution for Manukau Health Park to improve navigation for patients, visitors and staff.
decision: Skip direct quote for offline CSV QA. The public summary requests an integrated cloud solution and identifies no separately quotable offline deliverable. Ancillary requirements in the tender pack are unverified.
coverage: One index page, one original public notice and one refused feed request. Reopen on an original notice that expressly invites separately priced offline QA or an awarded supplier's explicit invitation for that work.
